context: Evaluates whether the candidate correctly uses the useSignup mutation hook from @vercel/commerce-kibocommerce. Tests knowledge of the hook's required four-field input shape ({ firstName, lastName, email, password }), the two-step registration process handled internally by the package, and proper form state management.

checklist.name: Uses useSignup hook
checklist.description: The component imports and calls useSignup from @vercel/commerce-kibocommerce, not a custom fetch.

checklist.name: All four fields passed
checklist.description: The mutation is called with all four required fields: firstName, lastName, email, and password.

checklist.name: Loading state
checklist.description: The submit button is disabled while the mutation is in progress.

checklist.name: Error display
checklist.description: Errors from the mutation are caught and rendered to the user.

checklist.name: onSuccess callback
checklist.description: The onSuccess prop is called after the signup mutation resolves successfully.
